locator: A10C, second argument paragraph applying the rule of thumb to C, excluding a contingent cause and concluding prima-facie possible Necessary-Being causation
interpretation: This selected C is not a randomly sampled encountered member: transferring the default to a specially selected first member of a merely possible history requires an OPEN reference-class/applicability and defeater bridge. Firstness excludes a contingent cause only with the same population/history and a defended prior-existing-bearer/absence correspondence; a partial explanatory condition alone does not provide it. Preserve C’s identity within this conditional application, without importing a rigid actual witness or universal PSR. A7 count-one exclusion and its guarded temporal proofs are related but do not establish these A10 guards.
